response.overview: This landmark and heavily controversial two-part special event marks the milestone 200th episode of the series, turning into a massive, meta-fictional celebration that quickly became a real-world legal nightmare. When a disgruntled Tom Cruise rallies over two hundred celebrities previously ridiculed by the show to launch a class-action lawsuit against the town, South Park faces total financial ruin. To drop the lawsuit, the celebrities demand only one thing: to see the Islamic prophet Muhammad uncensored so they can steal his magical immunity to ridicule. As multiple factions collide—including a ginger army of "Gingervitis" kids and Mecha-Streisand—the special delivers a historic commentary on fear, religious extremism, and corporate media censorship.
response.title: South Park: 200
